CustomField.description: The original Loan order this Return or Sale order was created from during loan-to-sale conversion. A custom self-lookup is used instead of the standard OriginalOrderId/RelatedOrderId because those are reserved for OMS Reduction/Change Orders, which require price books and line items the demo does not seed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The original loan order this return or sale order came from. Set automatically during loan-to-sale conversion.
